reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with NormedAddCommGroup,InnerProductSpace R,FiniteDimensional R,MeasurableSpace,BorelSpace instances and canonical full-space volume,including dimension zero. Let W:E->R be C2 and assume exp(-W) is volume-integrable and its volume integral strictly positive. Let m,M:R satisfy m>0 and m<=M. Assume for EVERY x,a:E BOTH genuine all-point/all-vector bounds
  m*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R W) x a) a,
  (fderiv R (fderiv R W) x a) a <= M*||a||^2.
Define mu=volume.tilted(x->-W(x)),the actual normalized exp(-W)/positive partition measure.
For EVERY original real-linear partial operator D:Lp R 2 mu->partialLinear[R] Lp E 2 mu,assume D.IsClosable and the exact graph iff: for every scalar L2 class b and vector L2 class G,(b,G) belongs to D.graph iff there exists a smooth compactly supported real phi with b=phi mu-AE and G=gradient(phi) mu-AE. D.closure is the actual closure of this same original graph on its submodule domain.
Then for EVERY z:D.closure.domain satisfying the actual centered condition integral (z as scalar L2 representative)(x) dmu(x)=0,
  m*||z as Lp R 2 mu||^2 <= ||D.closure(z)||^2.
These are genuine weighted scalar/vector quotient L2 norms. D is fixed before all centered z,not selected anew per input. Mean zero is with respect to actual mu;no assumed Poincare/coercivity/limit certificate or resolvent witness is an input. The original graph's smooth test functions have compact support,but z is a general actual closure-domain element without a compact-support condition. Both lower and upper C2 curvature assumptions are retained;this is not a lower-only contract. The inequality is output for every such centered z,not a premise. No probability-law change,pointwise rough Hessian,anisotropic Hessian-inverse inequality,joint measurable operator choice,normalized-score derivative,marginal inequality or main/cost composition statement is asserted.
objects: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel E;C2 W,actual positive integrable partition;real m,M;normalized Gibbs mu;universal original closable exact smooth compact gradient D and same closure;ALL centered closure-domain scalar elements z and genuine scalar/vector weighted norms.
domains: Displayed finite real inner-product/Borel instances,full-space volume,dimension0. W:E->R,m/M real,mu normalized exp(-W)/partition. Original D between actual Lp R2mu and Lp E2mu on submodule domain;z actual closure-domain element. Mean and inequality norms use mu,partition uses volume. Graph equalities mu-AE;no rough pointwise derivative premise.
quantifiers: Universal E,W,m,M under premises;Hessian bounds forall x,a. Let mu;forall D under closability/exact graph (forall scalar b/vector G iff exists smooth compact phi);forall z:SAME closure-domain,actual mu mean0 -> scalar norm inequality. No replacement D/test-dependent z or existential resolvent input.
assumptions: W C2,Integrable exp(-W) volume,positive partition;m>0,m<=M;BOTH actual all-point/all-vector nested-fderiv lower/upper bounds;original D closable/exact smooth compact graph;z in same closure-domain with genuine mean0. No supplied norm/limit/coercivity certificate,resolvent/epsilon0,compact z or density premise.
conclusion: For every centered closure-domain z,m*||scalar z||^2 <= ||vector closureD(z)||^2 with true weighted L2 norms.
scopes: Same original D before ALL z,closure-domain meanzero only,not pointwise compact test class. Both m/M bounds explicit,not lower-only. Result genuine centered weighted norm inequality with no further anisotropic/marginal/normalized-score/main/composition conclusion or measurable selector.
